_source: authored template grammar v1 for src/prompt-engine.js. Mirrored at runtime by data/prompt-templates.data.js (the .data.js file is what the browser loads; keep the two in sync).
_voice: terse, haunted, lowercase. no exclamation marks. no therapeutic jargon. slots: {interpretation} {cohort} {artifact} {verb} {intention}.
_families: verbs are free-form user input; 'verbs' lists the keyword family a template responds to (matched as substring of the lowercased verb). 'any' matches all verbs.
_gating: 'minCohort' (optional int): the template only joins the pool once artifacts+relations reach that tier (WS5 'the cohort becomes louder'). Templates without minCohort are always eligible.

templates.text: if {interpretation} were challenged, what would {cohort} do?
{cohort} keeps this close because it {verb}. what has the keeping cost?
what was exiled along with {artifact} that {cohort} still wants back?
{artifact} {verb} {cohort}. where does it aim, and who taught it to aim there?
if {interpretation} is a warning, what is {cohort} being warned of?
if {cohort} looked away first, what would {interpretation} do?
{cohort} {verb} this. where did the weight come from?
what would {cohort} put down if {interpretation} allowed it?
{cohort} {verb} this. what door is it holding shut?
if {interpretation} were allowed to speak, what would it say to {cohort}?
{artifact} sits beside {cohort} now. ask them both why.
where was {cohort} the day {interpretation} first happened?
write {cohort} a letter. let {interpretation} read it first.
you have said {cohort}'s name enough times that the room answers first. what does it answer?
{cohort} has carried {interpretation} beside you for a while. what would it set down if you asked?
{cohort} watched you make {artifact}. ask it what it saw that you did not.
